text:
Alex: Quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2456. Small refactor in pkg/exporter to avoid an NPE, plus a tiny rename. Tests pass locally but CI formatting check is failing (gofumpt). Need 2 approvals from owners for pkg/exporter. @Carmen can you eyeball the naming change? @Jess for format/lint follow-up.

Carmen: On it — quick scan looks fine. One thought: the new name `ExportCfg` is terse, can you add a comment explaining the abbreviation? I can review in ~30.

Jess: CI shows `format-check` failing on generated/models.pb.go. Did you regenerate protobufs? The linter flags a gofumpt mismatch, looks like generated files weren't touched.

Alex: Ah, I didn't run `make gen` before the branch. I thought generated files were unchanged. I'll run the regen and push. The failing job logs: `file generated/models.pb.go: gofumpt mismatch; run gofumpt -w .`

Tony: Heads-up from infra side: we try not to commit generated changes without running `tools/regen` so diffs are intentional. If you regenerate, add a line in the PR description. Also, pkg/exporter requires two approvers per CODEOWNERS — flagging that now.

Alex: Pushed regenerated files + a small extra comment on `ExportCfg`. I also ran `gofumpt -w` locally. CI still shows a one-line diff on generated/models.pb.go (line ~142) — weird. Snippet from the job: ```diff --gofumpt old/new ... line 142 spacing change```

Carmen: :thumbsup: I see the comment, thanks. Tiny nit: please expand the comment to clarify why abbreviation is used (backwards compatibility). Not blocking.

Jess: Another cause could be a gofumpt version mismatch between dev and CI. Our CI image uses v0.3.2, dev machines running v0.4.0 cause flaps like this. @eng-infra can we pin/upgrade the image or vendor the binary? For a quick unblock Alex, re-running `gofumpt` with the CI version or committing the CI-format output should pass.

eng-infra-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled a CI image update to include gofumpt v0.4.0 — ETA ~4h. For immediate unblock, either run the CI container locally to format or add `tools/gofumpt-version` to the repo.

Alex: Thanks — I pushed another tiny formatting commit using the CI container to ensure parity. Also rebased onto main to pick up the latest CI image changes. Requesting reviews @Carmen @Jess. I'll hold merge until approvals + oncall FYI.

Carmen: Approved. Left a comment suggesting `ExportCfg` -> `ExportConfiguration` if we're not tight on identifier length, but it's fine to keep as-is with the added comment.

Jess: Approved. Format-check is green now, one flaky unit test failed in metrics (unrelated). @Alex please squash the WIP commits and rebase if needed so it can land cleanly in the merge window.

Alex: Will squash and push shortly. Planning to merge at tomorrow's 09:00 PT merge window. Tagging @oncall as FYI. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround!

oncall: Noted — will watch the merge window. Ping if you want me to abort on any unexpected post-merge errors.

Alex: Appreciate it — I'll ping if anything pops after merge.
